supplements.title: Luteolin Ameliorates Sepsis-Induced Acute Lung Injury by Targeting RPTPα to Reprogram Macrophage M1-M2 Polarization.
supplements.summary: Luteolin, a natural compound, reduces lung inflammation in sepsis by targeting a protein that reprograms immune cells from pro-inflammatory to anti-inflammatory states.

supplements.title: Resveratrol-loaded liposomes regulate mitochondrial oxidative stress through the HIGD1A/NF-κB/SOD2 signaling pathway to improve chemotherapy-induced ovarian injury.
supplements.summary: Resveratrol-loaded liposomes protect ovarian cells from chemotherapy damage by reducing oxidative stress through a specific cellular pathway.

supplements.title: Hydroxytyrosol suppressed the nephrotoxicity of cisplatin while supporting its therapeutic potential in a rat model of hepatocellular carcinoma.
supplements.summary: Hydroxytyrosol protects kidneys from cisplatin damage while enhancing its cancer-fighting effect against hepatocellular carcinoma.

supplements.title: Mechanistic insights into ferroptosis in thyroid cancer and its therapeutic implications.
supplements.summary: Triggering ferroptosis, an iron-dependent cell death pathway, shows promise for treating thyroid cancer and overcoming radioiodine resistance.

supplements.title: Identification of natural compounds targeting the KRAS G12D mutation in pancreatic cancer through integrated in silico and in vitro approaches.
supplements.summary: Researchers identified natural compounds mangiferin and hesperetin that effectively block a common pancreatic cancer mutation, showing promise in early tests.

supplements.title: Sijunzi Decoction Reverses Metabolic Adaptation and Induces Ferroptosis in Cisplatin-Resistant Non-small Cell Lung Cancer: An Integrative Metabolomics-Pharmacology Analysis.
supplements.summary: Sijunzi Decoction overcomes drug resistance in lung cancer by blocking metabolic changes that help cancer cells survive chemotherapy.

supplements.title: The interplay of Ashwagandha with hormonal dynamics and gut microbiota in women with breast cancer: a tri-axial perspective.
supplements.summary: Ashwagandha may help fight breast cancer by suppressing tumor growth, boosting immune response, and altering gut bacteria, though clinical testing is needed.

supplements.title: Natural Products as Modulators of ABC Transporters in Breast Cancer.
supplements.summary: Natural plant products can inhibit drug-resistant breast cancer by blocking transporters that remove chemotherapy drugs from cancer cells.

supplements.title: Diet and risk of multiple myeloma: findings from a case-control study.
supplements.summary: Healthier diets reduce multiple myeloma risk, while inflammatory and insulin-promoting diets increase risk.

supplements.title: Liquorice alters adipocyte-breast cancer cell crosstalk by modulating oxidative stress and suppressing aromatase and renin-angiotensin signalling.
supplements.summary: Liquorice root extract reduces breast cancer cell growth by altering fat cell signals that normally promote tumors.

supplements.title: Neuroprotective effects of quercetin in animal models of neurodegenerative diseases: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
supplements.summary: Quercetin, a plant compound, improved memory and reduced brain inflammation and oxidative stress in animal models of neurodegenerative diseases.

supplements.title: Expressional deregulations of RET/PTC genes and different nutritional factors playing crucial role in the development of thyroid cancer in Pakistani female subjects.
supplements.summary: Thyroid cancer in Pakistani women may result from abnormal RET gene activity combined with poor dietary habits.

supplements.title: 4-Hydroxychalcone Exert the Anti-cancer Potential in Colorectal Cancer Through Targeting CDK6.
supplements.summary: A food compound called 4-hydroxychalcone fights colorectal cancer by targeting a specific protein called CDK6.

supplements.title: Allicin inhibits colon cancer cells biological activity by regulating lncRNA UCA1 via autophagy stimulating.
supplements.summary: Garlic compound allicin kills colon cancer cells by triggering a natural cellular cleanup process that reduces a cancer-promoting RNA molecule.

supplements.title: Curative effect of acupuncture combined with Chinese medicine on cancer pain: Systematic review and meta-analysis.
supplements.summary: Acupuncture combined with Chinese medicine may help reduce cancer pain, according to a review of multiple studies.

off_label.title: ICMT supports BRAFV600E-driven tumor growth by membrane targeting of the CAAX protein INPP5E.
off_label.summary: Blocking ICMT protein in melanoma prevents a cancer-supporting protein from reaching cell membranes, slowing tumor growth.

off_label.title: Preemptive cardioprotection with a small molecule in rodents that suppresses genes predictive of heart failure.
off_label.summary: A small molecule drug given before heart surgery reduced heart damage by 70% and prevented heart failure in rats by suppressing inflammation.

off_label.title: Orlistat potentiates the gemcitabine effect in inhibiting the malignant biological behavior of nasopharyngeal carcinoma by downregulating PKM2.
off_label.summary: Adding the weight loss drug orlistat to gemcitabine chemotherapy improves treatment effectiveness against nasopharyngeal cancer by reducing a specific cancer-promoting protein.

off_label.title: HOXD11-NMDAR signaling drives neuroendocrine prostate cancer and enables potential therapeutic intervention as a target of memantine.
off_label.summary: HOXD11 drives treatment-resistant neuroendocrine prostate cancer, and the drug memantine may block this transformation by targeting NMDAR signaling.

off_label.title: Soluble Uric Acid Drives CD8⁺ T-cell Exhaustion by Inducing KSR1-Mediated MAPK Hyperactivation.
off_label.summary: High uric acid exhausts immune cells in colorectal cancer; lowering it restores anti-tumor immunity and enhances immunotherapy effectiveness.

off_label.title: Targeting the GSK-3β/mTOR axis to overcome chemoresistance in gestational choriocarcinoma: molecular mechanisms and therapeutic opportunities.
off_label.summary: Blocking GSK-3β and mTOR proteins may overcome chemotherapy resistance in gestational choriocarcinoma by restoring cancer cell death.

off_label.title: Rituximab Beyond Oncology: Targeting B-Cell-Mediated Immunomodulatory Therapy in Neurodegenerative and Neuropsychiatric Disorders.
off_label.summary: Rituximab, a B-cell-targeting drug, shows promise treating multiple neurological disorders by reducing brain inflammation and protecting neurons.

off_label.title: The telomerase/shelterin system is impaired in acromegaly and Cushing´s disease: Potential pathophysiological relevance.
off_label.summary: Pituitary tumor cells show abnormal telomerase activity that can be blocked with a drug to reduce growth, potentially offering a new treatment approach.

off_label.title: mTOR inhibition promotes ATRA-induced cancer cell differentiation by overcoming a metabolic hyperactive state.
off_label.summary: Combining mTOR inhibitors with vitamin A derivative ATRA improves cancer cell maturation in treatment-resistant acute myeloid leukemia and solid tumors.

off_label.title: Decreased PP2A expression and activity represent a therapeutic target for plexiform neurofibroma.
off_label.summary: Restoring PP2A phosphatase activity with FTY720 suppresses neurofibroma growth in NF1, alone and combined with MEK inhibitors.

off_label.title: MCL1 inhibition to enhance the efficacy of MYB targeting in pediatric acute myeloid leukemia.
off_label.summary: Combining MCL1 inhibition with mebendazole—which targets MYB—significantly improves treatment of pediatric acute myeloid leukemia without chemotherapy toxicity.

off_label.title: From anthelmintic to neuro-oncology: A systematic review of mebendazole repurposing for brain tumour therapy.
off_label.summary: Mebendazole, an existing anti-parasite drug, shows promise against brain tumors through multiple cancer-fighting mechanisms and effective brain penetration.

off_label.title: Aspirin mitigates sepsis-associated encephalopathy by modulating ICAM-1 and MMP-9 signaling: Evidence from clinical cohorts and mechanistic experiments.
off_label.summary: Aspirin reduces sepsis-associated brain inflammation and cognitive damage by suppressing immune cell adhesion and protecting the blood-brain barrier.

off_label.title: Phase III randomized placebo-controlled trial on repurposing olanzapine for prevention of radiotherapy induced nausea and vomiting (RINV): CTRI/2022/01/039723.
off_label.summary: Olanzapine, an existing psychiatric drug, significantly reduced nausea and vomiting in cancer patients undergoing abdominal-pelvic radiation therapy.

off_label.title: Integrated clinical and computational data-based repurposing of econazole as a novel autophagic activator in ULK1-related Parkinson disease.
off_label.summary: Econazole, an existing antifungal drug, activates autophagy and shows promise for treating Parkinson disease by clearing toxic protein aggregates.

biomarkers.title: Highlights of the San Antonio breast cancer symposium 2025 (Part 2).
biomarkers.summary: The 2025 San Antonio Breast Cancer Symposium presented advances in breast imaging, targeted drugs, and supportive treatments for improved patient outcomes.

biomarkers.title: Novel multiplex immunofluorescence-based tumor inflammation score provides apparent predictive biomarker in a phase I/II study of pembrolizumab with gemcitabine in patients with previously-treated advanced non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC).
biomarkers.summary: A new tumor inflammation score combining immune cell relationships better predicts lung cancer treatment response than standard biomarkers in pembrolizumab studies.

biomarkers.title: Centromere protein I promotes hepatocellular carcinoma progression by activating PI3K/AKT/mTOR-CDK2 cascade.
biomarkers.summary: A protein called CENPI drives hepatocellular carcinoma progression by activating a cellular growth pathway, potentially offering a new treatment target.

biomarkers.title: Results of breast cancer risk assessment and hereditary cancer genetic testing in community obstetrics and gynaecology practice following a prospective quality Improvement initiative.
biomarkers.summary: A community women's health program successfully integrated hereditary breast cancer genetic testing, improving identification of high-risk patients needing specialized care.

biomarkers.title: Wt1 facilitates visceral beige fat formation to combat abdominal obesity.
biomarkers.summary: Wt1 gene promotes heat-generating beige fat in abdominal tissue, offering a potential treatment for obesity caused by diet or steroids.

biomarkers.title: Reprogramming endogenous NK circuits by highly efficient nonviral genome editing.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed a highly efficient method to genetically reprogram natural killer cells without viruses, enabling improved cancer-fighting capabilities and clinical manufacturing.

biomarkers.title: Regulatory T cells sabotage anti-tumor γδ T cells by creating IL-2-deficient environments.
biomarkers.summary: Removing regulatory T cells unleashes immune cells that fight breast cancer by restoring their access to a critical growth signal.

biomarkers.title: Beyond chromatin accessibility: bulk ATAC-seq as an integrative assay to portray genomes and epigenomes.
biomarkers.summary: ATAC-seq can detect genetic mutations, DNA copy changes, and telomere content, offering a cost-effective alternative to standard sequencing for cancer profiling.

biomarkers.title: Hepatocyte growth factor/c-Met signaling axis in human diseases: Mechanistic insights and therapeutic potential.
biomarkers.summary: HGF/c-Met pathway dysregulation drives cancer and other diseases, offering therapeutic targets through c-Met inhibitors and HGF antagonists.

biomarkers.title: ICMT supports BRAFV600E-driven tumor growth by membrane targeting of the CAAX protein INPP5E.
biomarkers.summary: Blocking ICMT protein in melanoma prevents a cancer-supporting protein from reaching cell membranes, slowing tumor growth.

biomarkers.title: Human pannexin mutations and their implications in erosive osteoarthritis.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified two pannexin gene mutations causing erosive hand osteoarthritis through opposite effects on cell channel activity and cell death.

biomarkers.title: From hotspots to hotspaces: Cascaded photonic-plasmonic coupling for SERS-based deep profiling of whole small extracellular vesicles.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed a new technology that detects colorectal cancer biomarkers in blood with 99.8% accuracy by improving how light interacts with tiny particles.

biomarkers.title: Glycerol-mediated nose-to-brain codelivery of anti-IL-17 and anti-CD73 antibodies enhances immunotherapy for melanoma brain metastases.
biomarkers.summary: Glycerol-assisted nasal delivery of two antibodies effectively treats melanoma brain tumors by boosting immune cell activity and overcoming tumor immune-evasion tactics.

biomarkers.title: Preemptive cardioprotection with a small molecule in rodents that suppresses genes predictive of heart failure.
biomarkers.summary: A small molecule drug given before heart surgery reduced heart damage by 70% and prevented heart failure in rats by suppressing inflammation.

biomarkers.title: High mannose content of mesenchymal glioblastoma correlates with hydroxyl proton transfer-weighted (HPTw) MRI as noninvasive biomarker of tumor aggressiveness.
biomarkers.summary: High mannose levels in aggressive glioblastoma can be detected non-invasively using MRI, potentially predicting tumor aggressiveness and recurrence.

trials.title: Acupuncture for chemotherapy-induced dysgeusia (AcuDysg): a randomized controlled trial.
trials.summary: Acupuncture combined with self-acupressure may help reduce chemotherapy's side effect of taste changes in cancer patients.

trials.title: The effect of mindfulness-based stress reduction on chemotherapy-related physical and psychological distress in colorectal cancer patients: a retrospective cohort study.
trials.summary: Mindfulness-based stress reduction may help reduce nausea, vomiting, depression, and anxiety in colorectal cancer patients undergoing chemotherapy.

trials.title: Highlights of the San Antonio breast cancer symposium 2025 (Part 2).
trials.summary: The 2025 San Antonio Breast Cancer Symposium presented advances in breast imaging, targeted drugs, and supportive treatments for improved patient outcomes.

trials.title: Novel multiplex immunofluorescence-based tumor inflammation score provides apparent predictive biomarker in a phase I/II study of pembrolizumab with gemcitabine in patients with previously-treated advanced non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC).
trials.summary: A new tumor inflammation score combining immune cell relationships better predicts lung cancer treatment response than standard biomarkers in pembrolizumab studies.

trials.title: Results of breast cancer risk assessment and hereditary cancer genetic testing in community obstetrics and gynaecology practice following a prospective quality Improvement initiative.
trials.summary: A community women's health program successfully integrated hereditary breast cancer genetic testing, improving identification of high-risk patients needing specialized care.

trials.title: Reprogramming endogenous NK circuits by highly efficient nonviral genome editing.
trials.summary: Researchers developed a highly efficient method to genetically reprogram natural killer cells without viruses, enabling improved cancer-fighting capabilities and clinical manufacturing.

trials.title: Glycerol-mediated nose-to-brain codelivery of anti-IL-17 and anti-CD73 antibodies enhances immunotherapy for melanoma brain metastases.
trials.summary: Glycerol-assisted nasal delivery of two antibodies effectively treats melanoma brain tumors by boosting immune cell activity and overcoming tumor immune-evasion tactics.

trials.title: Targeted introduction of T cell receptor genes at the TRAC locus in cytotoxic T lymphocytes regenerated from human iPSCs by genome editing.
trials.summary: Researchers successfully engineered cancer-fighting T cells from stem cells by safely inserting tumor-targeting genes at a specific location using genome editing.

trials.title: Efficacy and Safety of Camrelizumab Plus Apatinib in Patients With Refractory Chordoma: A Phase II Clinical Trial.
trials.summary: A combination drug treatment shows promise for treating hard-to-treat chordoma, a rare bone cancer.

trials.title: Semen RNA-Based Biomarkers for Prostate Cancer Detection and Risk Stratification: A Prospective Multi-Center Validation Study.
trials.summary: Semen RNA biomarkers successfully identify prostate cancer and distinguish between cancer severity levels in a large validation study.

trials.title: uPAR is highly expressed in recurrent glioblastoma and represents a candidate CAR T cell target.
trials.summary: Researchers identified uPAR protein as a promising target for CAR T cell therapy in recurrent glioblastoma, showing strong anti-tumor activity in patient models.

trials.title: Diagnostic performance of abbreviated non-contrast liver MRI for detecting synchronous colorectal liver metastases.
trials.summary: Abbreviated non-contrast MRI scans effectively detect colorectal cancer spread to the liver, offering a faster, cheaper alternative to standard contrast-enhanced imaging.

trials.title: Novel anti-Mullerian hormone receptor 2 binding peptide prevents chemotherapy-related ovarian follicle loss in a mouse model.
trials.summary: Researchers developed a peptide that mimics natural hormones to protect ovaries from chemotherapy damage and preserve fertility in mice.

trials.title: Argon plasma coagulation, endoscopic mucosal resection, and endoscopic submucosal dissection for gastric low-grade dysplasia: a multicenter inverse probability-weighted cohort study.
trials.summary: Researchers compared three endoscopic procedures for treating early gastric cancer precursors, finding different effectiveness rates among argon plasma coagulation, mucosal resection, and submucosal dissection.

trials.title: MRI radiomics predicting cribriform growth informs active surveillance decision in intermediate-risk prostate cancer.
trials.summary: MRI analysis predicts aggressive prostate cancer growth patterns, helping doctors safely select intermediate-risk patients for monitoring instead of immediate treatment.
